# Dr. Akshay Parmar: Prosthodontist in Hamilton and Jersey City, NJ

> Personal professional website of Dr. Akshay Parmar, BDS, DDS, MDSc, FACP, FAAMP.
> Board-certified prosthodontist and fellowship-trained maxillofacial prosthodontist.
> He currently works as an associate at both practices below; he does not own them.
> Each practice manages its own appointments, treatment fees and billing.

## Where to see Dr. Parmar
- Hamilton: Dr. Joseph Randazzo’s practice, 1544 Kuser Road, Suite C3, Hamilton, NJ 08619. Call (609) 585-1616.
- Jersey City: Dental Associates of Jersey City, 2766 John F. Kennedy Boulevard, Jersey City, NJ 07306. Call (201) 433-0773.
- Ask specifically to schedule with Dr. Akshay Parmar. Confirm his availability and consultation fee with the chosen office.
- [Hamilton location](https://drparmardds.com/locations/hamilton/)
- [Jersey City location](https://drparmardds.com/locations/jersey-city/)

## Patients considering travel
Dr. Parmar welcomes inquiries from across New Jersey, New York City and Philadelphia. His two current clinical locations are Hamilton and Jersey City, NJ; there is no NYC or Philadelphia office. Treatment suitability, appointment availability, fees and follow-up are confirmed by the treating practice.
- [Planning travel for specialist care](https://drparmardds.com/traveling-for-care/)

## Clinical approach
Dr. Parmar connects diagnosis, surgical and restorative planning, final teeth and maintenance with the team at the treating practice. Treatment and setting depend on the individual evaluation.

Dr. Parmar holds BDS, DDS, MDSc degrees, is a Diplomate of the American Board
of Prosthodontics, a Fellow of the American College of Prosthodontists (FACP)
and of the American Academy of Maxillofacial Prosthetics (FAAMP), trained at
Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, and teaches implant surgery and
prosthodontics internationally.

## Services
- [Dental implants](https://drparmardds.com/dental-implants-new-jersey/): single and multiple implants, placed and restored by a specialist
- [All-on-4 / All-on-X full-arch implants](https://drparmardds.com/full-arch-implants-new-jersey/): surgery, same-day provisional teeth where appropriate, final bridge and maintenance coordinated by one specialist-led team
- [Immediate implants](https://drparmardds.com/immediate-implant-rehabilitation/): implant placement with same-day provisional teeth
- [Full mouth reconstruction](https://drparmardds.com/full-mouth-reconstruction-new-jersey/): rebuilding a failing dentition as one coordinated plan
- [Worn teeth and bite reconstruction](https://drparmardds.com/tooth-wear-rehabilitation/): restoring lost vertical dimension
- [Porcelain veneers](https://drparmardds.com/veneers-aesthetic-reconstruction/): conservative specialist veneers and smile design
- [Maxillofacial prosthodontics](https://drparmardds.com/maxillofacial-rehabilitation/): obturators and rehabilitation after oral cancer surgery
- [Teeth whitening](https://drparmardds.com/teeth-whitening/): specialist-supervised whitening
